purpose: Routing scheme frozen before computing cost. Fixes the marker-to-treatment-axis mapping and the cost-direction hypothesis before results are seen.

axes.rationale: MSI-H has known H&E correlates (tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes, medullary morphology) -> expected H&E-visible, low substitution cost.

axes.definition: all_ras==0 AND braf_v600==0 (all-RAS = KRAS/NRAS codon 12/13/61 activating)
axes.rationale: RAS mutation expected H&E-silent (no morphological correlate) -> the closer prediction is to random, the higher the routing substitution cost. Colorectal counterpart of breast HER2 (H&E-blind, high cost).
BRAF-V600 partially correlates with morphology (CMS1/MSI, right-sided tumours) -> partially visible (previous internal holdout AUROC 0.868).

cost_metric.lead: misroute_rate = routing disagreement rate (measured marker vs H&E-predicted marker). Distance-independent; like-with-like with breast receptor routing.
cost_metric.mean_cost: Weighted by frozen_map therapeutic distance. Only antiBRAF__baseline=0.868 exists in the frozen map. MSI (ICI) and anti-EGFR (antibody) axes are excluded from frozen_map (monoculture does not capture ICI/antibody efficacy) -> mean_cost=null; a separately preregistered clinical distance is required.

comparison_rule: Internal holdout vs internal holdout only. Not mixed with breast CPTAC external-transfer results. Mutation axis vs mutation axis (breast HER2 vs colorectal all-RAS).
